rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: IDA Pro plugin that integrates MCP support for automated binary vulnerability analysis and security scanning. Provides dangerous function detection, command injection analysis, buffer overflow detection, format string vulnerability scanning, and call graph visualization with taint propagation paths. Includes specialized support for embedded device firmware analysis with vendor-specific function recognition for routers from D-Link, TP-Link, Netgear, ASUS, Tenda, Huawei, and Xiaomi. Features both a web-based dashboard and native IDA Chooser windows for integrated analysis workflows.
